description: This file defines the Factory class within the OpenCart system engine, responsible for creating instances of controllers, models, and libraries based on sanitized route inputs. It dynamically generates class names and loads the corresponding classes if available.

classes.name: Factory
classes.description: A class responsible for dynamically instantiating controllers, models, and libraries in the OpenCart system based on route strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Factory with a Registry instance.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a controller class based on the route. Sanitizes the route and constructs the class name dynamically.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a model class based on the route. Sanitizes the route and constructs the class name dynamically.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of a library class based on the route and arguments. Sanitizes the route and constructs the class name dynamically.
